source_grid_estimator.purpose: closest reproducible interpretation of the paper's stated 1/36 calculation grid
source_grid_estimator.centers: integer q=(i/36,j/36) centers retained iff inside shrunken K-HBZ and outside every Gamma exclusion

mephc_clipped_domain_estimator.purpose: exact deterministic quadrature of the source-bound retained polygonal domain
mephc_clipped_domain_estimator.cell_region: cell intersect shrunken HBZ minus Gamma exclusions
mephc_clipped_domain_estimator.full_cell: one original cell-center sample with full weight
mephc_clipped_domain_estimator.clipped_cell: sequential convex half-plane subtraction followed by deterministic fan triangulation

normalization_fixture: constant Omega_q integrates to constant times the estimator weight sum before the 1/(2*pi) prefactor
